LESSON: LABORATORY APPARATUS AND INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Scientific Investigation
Topic 1.3: Laboratory apparatus and instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Laboratory apparatus and instruments
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are basic science skills important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the basic skills in science
2. use and care for apparatus and instruments in the laboratory
3. use the SI units for basic and derived quantities in science
4. appreciate consumer protection when handling different apparatus, instruments, and other materials in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Laboratory apparatus and instruments

Teach
• Observe Laboratory apparatus and instruments in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Laboratory apparatus and instruments (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe the basic skills in science
• use and care for apparatus and instruments in the laboratory
• use the SI units for basic and derived quantities in science

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Laboratory apparatus and instruments: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are basic science skills important?
2. How are quantities in science expressed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the basic skills in science
• use and care for apparatus and instruments in the laboratory
• use the SI units for basic and derived quantities in science
• appreciate consumer protection when handling different apparatus, instruments, and other materials in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
